results.name: Eli Lilly & Co.
results.description: Eli Lilly & Co. is an American global pharmaceutical company with headquarters located in Indianapolis, Indiana, in the United States. The company was incorporated on January 17, 1901.

results.name: LLYC (Llorente & Cuenca SA)
results.description: Llorente & Cuenca SA (doing business as LLYC) was incorporated on July 2 1996. It is a global communications and public affairs consulting firm. As of June 28, 2021, LLYC Partners SL holds more than 50% of the company's shares.

results.name: LLYC Partners SL
results.description: LLYC Partners SL was incorporated on April 5, 2021 to group together the shares of the LLYC group's partners. It operates as a global communications and public affairs consulting firm.
